summary: Career Soft and Atlus's tactical RPG successor to Langrisser, covering the six main games, localized PS2 compilations, and PSP enhanced/remake routes.

entries.title: Growlanser

emulation.notes: Use PPSSPP for clean scaling if a legal PSP copy is available.

primary.why: The first Growlanser was released on PlayStation and Windows, then received an enhanced PSP remake; the PSP version is the most complete documented release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PSP remake on original hardware, PPSSPP, or a Vita/PSP-compatible setup if available; use PlayStation or Windows only for historical comparison.

all_releases.reason: skip: original route, superseded by the enhanced PSP remake.
skip: PC port is historical and not the most complete documented release.
primary: most complete documented version of the first game.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PSP remake is the latest and most complete documented route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official English localization for the first game is documented in the consulted public sources.

entries.title: Growlanser II: The Sense of Justice

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 or PS2 hardware; no separate modern remaster is documented.

primary.why: Growlanser II is a PS2 title; in North America it was released with Growlanser III as Growlanser Generations, which is the localized practical route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Growlanser II through the PlayStation 2 Growlanser Generations release on hardware or PCSX2.

all_releases.fidelity: PS2 tactical RPG, localized in the Growlanser Generations package.
all_releases.reason: primary: only platform and localized practical route.

primary.version: PSP Over Reloaded / North American Wayfarer of Time
